focus: Adjective-as-noun (to chirotero = the worst thing, no noun needed) is earned - only fix is swapping the em dash for an en dash.
'More' goes plural (pio polla) because money (ta lefta) is plural - romanize ta lefta and replace the em dash.
Loan color kafe never changes form (indeclinable) - add romanization (kafe) and replace the em dash.
mou paei is literally 'it goes to me' = it suits me - lead with the literal logic instead of a bare phrase gloss.
kratao = hold AND last - make the hold-to-lasts landmine explicit instead of the bare 'here = it lasts' gloss.
The earned point is the polite plural forate for customers - lead with it, romanize forate, drop the megethos gloss and the em dash.
chtipao is literally 'hit' - shoes 'hit' you in Greek = they pinch; add the literal hook and replace the em dash.
mou kanei is literally 'it does for me' = it fits/works for me - add the literal logic and replace the em dash.
kastanos for eyes/hair vs kafe for objects is a real trap - just add the missing romanization for kafe.
echei zoi 'has life' = it's lively is earned - only fix is the em dash.
toso... oso = as... as is earned - romanize the card's own chunk toso akrivo oso.
No article in me proino when asking what's included is earned - only fix is the em dash.
One-off commands use the short aorist stem (klise, not kline) - say it in plain words, romanize klino, replace the em dash.
Second telling of the double-accent rule (el-2106 introduces it) - take a different angle: WHY it happens, the accentless possessive leans on the noun; romanize onoma/mou.
kali/kalo + noun is the all-purpose Greek wish pattern (kali diamoni, kalo taxidi) - generalize past the single formula and replace the em dash.
The yparchei vs echei register contrast is earned - romanize echei and replace the em dash.
zitao signomi is literally 'ask forgiveness', with the person as an object (mas zitisan) - lead with that literal logic.
Imperfect scene vs aorist event is earned - add romanization for fisouse and argise.
Imperfect for open-ended waiting is earned - only fix is the em dash.
echei kima 'has wave' = rough sea is earned - only fix is the em dash.
edese literally 'it tied' = it docked is earned - only fix is the em dash.
Greek requires the double negative kanena... den - romanize the quoted chunk and replace the em dash.
Long background imperfect + arrival aorist is earned - add romanization for taxidevame and ftasame.
'The sea was oil' = dead calm is earned - romanize thalassa and replace the em dash.
girizo = go around AND come back - romanize it, quote the card's girisame, replace the em dash.
dipla sto kima 'next to the wave' = right on the water is earned - only fix is the em dash.
Imperfect for a mental state (thelame - the not-wanting was a state) - romanize thelame and replace the em dash.
Article + dio = 'both' (i tous dio) is earned - only fix is the em dash.
Two imperfects = pure scene-setting is earned - romanize itan/odigousame and replace the em dash.
meno apo 'be left from petrol' = run out of is earned - add romanization for the dictionary form meno.
mi(n) not den for commands and advice is earned - only fix is the em dash.
ena vradi + aorist = one specific event is earned - add romanization for ena vradi.
xafnika + aorist = the sudden event is earned - add romanization for xafnika.
The were-walking-when-we-saw interruption pattern is earned - add romanization for perpatousame and eidame.
Habitual imperfect for repeated storytelling (elege) is earned - only fix is the em dash.
gnorizo = to know, but its aorist = met for the first time - add romanization for the dictionary form gnorizo.
me pire o ipnos 'sleep took me' = I dozed off is earned - only fix is the em dash.
Edge case: imperfect wins even on 'one night' when duration is the point - drop the jargon 'durative', romanize ena vradi, replace the em dash.
axizei na + verb = worth ...ing is earned - add romanization for pas in the card quote.
echei kosmo 'has people' = it's crowded is earned - only fix is the em dash.
Adverbs form comparatives with -otera (noris to noritera) - state the pattern, romanize noris, replace the em dash.
